Vulnerabilities.Title: aiohttp: Directory traversal vulnerability in HTTP server static file handling
Vulnerabilities.Description: aiohttp is an asynchronous HTTP client/server framework for asyncio and Python. An improper path validation flaw allows remote attackers to traverse directories and read arbitrary files.
